findings.actual: Both are parsed as common_chat_schema_any_of and emitted as grammar alternatives. This does not enforce exclusive exactly-one semantics on overlapping branches.
findings.recommendation: Use a root oneOf containing self-contained full object schemas. Give branches mutually exclusive kind/tool const discriminants; do not depend on shared root properties/required because the parser returns alternatives first.

findings.actual: A const arbitrary JSON value or each enum value becomes a literal JSON grammar string.
findings.recommendation: command const:'' for non-input; kind/tool const; argv const:['0'] or const:[] supported. A free summary must remain free rather than forcing the expected success/nonce.

findings.actual: items object plus minItems/maxItems makes a repeated item grammar with specified bounds.
prefixItems array without items is parsed as KIND_TUPLE and emits exactly those N entries; tuple conversion closes bracket immediately.
findings.caution: The tuple parser returns before reading minItems/maxItems. Equal redundant min=max=N has the same generated behavior, but those constraints are not independently processed. Prefer omitting redundant min/max.

findings.actual: If both are present, items wins. items:{} makes unrestricted items; items:false fails because schema nodes must be objects.
findings.recommendation: Never combine prefixItems with items for this pinned runtime; especially do not add modern-draft items:false.
tests: array with empty items and prefixItems

findings.actual: Required properties and false additionalProperties are represented in each object branch. Boolean false additionalProperties means no extra-property grammar.
findings.recommendation: Repeat a complete object shape with required all wire fields and additionalProperties:false in each branch.

findings.actual: Anchored basic regex supports alternation, groups, classes and bounded quantifiers. Unsupported patterns degrade to unrestricted strings with warning rather than becoming a semantic security boundary.
findings.recommendation: Keep existing integer/bounds/viewport/pixel guards; grammar narrows syntactic model choices, not proof of coordinate validity.

projected_document.source_only_conclusion: The proposed disjoint tool branches use the implemented GBNF subset. Exact generated grammar and counterexample checks still require an offline compiled pinned converter; this audit does not claim those checks ran.

qualification_scope: Only the claims within the original stage apply; this projection adds no phone or model test.
